newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares seen positioned for more gains.
newsitem.headline: German shares seen positioned for more gains.

text.p: The German share market, firm in after-hours electronic dealings on Thursday afternoon, is well positioned for further gains, dealers said.
The 30-share IBIS DAX index was up 15.12 points, or 0.56 percent, at 2,720.18 points at 1354 GMT, just below its intra-day high and some four points up on the close of bourse dealings.
DTB DAX futures were up 11 at 2,732.0.
Uncertainty about the Russian political sitation had helped create a scrappy day's trading with profit-taking evident in some sectors, but dealers said the overall outlook seemed good.
Daimler-Benz AG was however supported after sources said the group was considering plans to fully integrate its Mercedes-Benz car unit.
The stock was up 1.32 marks at 88.45 marks.
